record.summary: Voluntary, non-binding code that helps organisations turn Malaysia's seven AI principles, set out in the National Guidelines on AI Governance and Ethics, into practice across the design, development and deployment of AI systems. It is aimed at organisations, AI developers, deployers and researchers and is available in English and Bahasa Melayu. It does not replace, override or modify any legal requirement, and may be reviewed and updated over time.
record.notes: Issued by AI Malaysia Berhad (National AI Office), the national agency under the Ministry of Digital. The AICE page gives no publication date, so none is recorded. The code is available in English and Bahasa Melayu.
